Chapters guide

Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise — GTA 6 progression guide

You play mostly as Jason around Key Lento in the Leonida Keys, running smuggling, rent-collection and repair jobs for Brian, Cal and Donnie. Lucia is released from prison partway through and the pair reunite; the chapter teaches driving, diving and the BuckMe banking system before a finale run that costs Jason his house.

Missions — what sources report

Dexerto's verified mission list counts 22 mandatory missions in this chapter, Prologue included, and 91 across the game (cross-checked by G2A against PC Gamer, GamesRadar+ and PowerPyx). The rival 93 total adds two optional Chapter 2 Billy missions (Thrillbillies; Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab); longer lists such as GTABase's 122 count banking sub-tasks and steps as separate entries, and PowerPyx adds optional/missable tasks (Get Shirley's Rum, Steal the Scooter) on top.

What unlocks

  • BuckMe checking account and ATM deposits (mission: Buck Me)
  • Family Savings account in the BuckMe app (mission: Buck Me)
  • Floorboard cash stash at Jason's house
  • Ammu-Nation weapon purchases (mission: Gear Up)
  • Kenton's treasure dives (mission: Island Dreams)
  • Ultimate Edition Chapter 1 items: Dinka Enduro, Crest kayak, Ganado Retro Build
  • Lab Fees door codes: Moonstone Boutique hidden lab 0420 and Brian's lockup 7700 (Space4Games and code lists)

Free grabs this act

  • Jason's Ganado, his starting personal car
  • $5,000 Rainy Day Fund lockbox hidden under Jason's floorboards (set up in Chapter 1, collected after the house burns)
  • Ultimate Edition weapons, free from the weapon locker at any Ammu-Nation

Warnings & traps

  • Tourist Trap is the point of no return: starting it wipes pocket cash, your BuckMe checking balance, the floor stash, Jason's house and ALL personal vehicles including Ultimate Edition cars and paid upgrades
  • Only Family Savings survives the wipe, and it caps at $5,000 in Chapter 1 — move $5,000 in and spend the rest on guns, clothes or tattoos, which all carry over
  • Do not pay for upgrades on Jason's car; it is lost at the chapter's end
  • Sources disagree on the exact trigger: KeenGamer names Tourist Trap, while GuruGamer and others warn pocket cash is already lost when Recalibration starts — prepare before Recalibration to be safe
  • Finish Shirley's missable errands and accept Lucia's balcony meditation (tied to the Positive Mental Attitude trophy) before the finale; both are unavailable afterwards
  • There is no mission replay, so keep a separate manual save from before the finale chain

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: GTA 6 Chapter 2 Lost Money: What Carries Over and How to Get It Back — KeenGamer.

Source: How to Keep Your Money When Chapter 1 Ends in GTA 6 — GuruGamer.

Source: All Chapters & Main Story Missions in GTA 6 — GameRant.

Source: GTA 6 Mission List — All Chapters and Missions — Dexerto.

High confidence on the wipe mechanics — KeenGamer, GuruGamer, RareThief and Exputer agree on what is lost and kept. Mission counts are now settled (22 here; 91 mandatory game-wide). The Recalibration-versus-Tourist-Trap trigger remains a live disagreement, and one detail is disputed: most guides tie BuckMe banking to the Buck Me mission, while some place banking access around Coming Home.
